parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

parameters.name: engine_name
parameters.description:
Tool engine name (e.g. `assets`, `rfi`). Matches `Tool.engine_name`
for `provider_type` Project.

get.description:
Returns IDs of projects under a company that have a project-scoped Tool
record for the given `engine_name`.

By default (no parameters) returns only projects that are active and
for which the tool has both `is_active` and `is_available` true —
matching the same criteria as `Project#has_active_tool?`.

**`tool_status`**: `true` (default) — tool has both `is_active` and
`is_available` true. `false` — either field is false.

**`project_status`**: `true` (default) — active projects only.
`false` — inactive projects only.

parameters.name: tool_status
parameters.description:
Tool activation status. `true` (default) — both `is_active` and
`is_available` are true, matching `Project#has_active_tool?`.
`false` — either field is false.

parameters.name: project_status
parameters.description:
Project active state. `true` (default) — active projects only.
`false` — inactive projects only.
